name: china-open-vlm-redline
purpose: Hard allowlist for OpenRouter tests tied to the Jetson Orin Nano multimodal project.
hard_rules: Only models listed in allowed_models may be executed by run_openrouter_eval.js.
Default testing favors open or open-weight Chinese vision-language models.
Large API-only or non-open reference models must stay disabled unless this allowlist is edited deliberately.
Do not add non-China closed models to this file unless they are used as a clearly labeled reference baseline.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-8b-instruct
allowed_models.project_fit: Closest cloud proxy for a small local/edge VLM; use first for Jetson-feasibility checks.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-instruct
allowed_models.project_fit: Higher-quality Qwen VL candidate for cloud-assisted edge workflow and quality ceiling.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-32b-instruct
allowed_models.project_fit: Dense Qwen VL comparison point for OCR, chart, table, and spatial reasoning.

allowed_models.label: glm-4.6v
allowed_models.project_fit: Non-Qwen Chinese VLM baseline for robustness comparison.

allowed_models.label: glm-5v-turbo
allowed_models.project_fit: Newer GLM vision turbo candidate for robustness and latency comparison against Qwen.

allowed_models.label: qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
allowed_models.project_fit: Older strong open Qwen VL upper baseline; useful when small models fail.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-8b-thinking
allowed_models.project_fit: Reasoning variant for difficult spatial/chart items; use sparingly because completion tokens may rise.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-30b-a3b-thinking
allowed_models.project_fit: Reasoning upper check after instruct models; disabled from default smoke run for budget control.

allowed_models.label: ernie-4.5-vl-28b-a3b
allowed_models.project_fit: Chinese MoE VLM alternative for document, table, chart, and video-style tasks.

allowed_models.label: internvl3-14b
allowed_models.project_fit: OpenGVLab VLM family baseline exposed by OpenRouter; useful independent comparison against Qwen.

allowed_models.label: internvl3-78b
allowed_models.project_fit: Large InternVL3 quality baseline from a high-ranking open VLM family.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-instruct
allowed_models.project_fit: Qwen3-VL high-end open MoE quality ceiling for cloud fallback comparisons.

allowed_models.label: qwen3-vl-235b-a22b-thinking
allowed_models.project_fit: Qwen3-VL reasoning ceiling; use sparingly because thinking responses can expand output tokens.

allowed_models.label: qwen3.5-9b-api-reference
allowed_models.project_fit: Qwen3.5 reference for the user's original target; not part of open-source-first smoke run.

allowed_models.label: qwen3.5-27b-api-reference
allowed_models.project_fit: Larger Qwen3.5 reference for checking whether the general multimodal line beats Qwen3-VL on project tasks.

allowed_models.label: qwen3.5-flash-api-reference
allowed_models.project_fit: Fast Qwen3.5 reference for cloud-assisted workflow; not a local open model target.
